value.rationale: A complete exact classification for arbitrarily tall, nonuniform level-homogeneous trees: two-variable blindness beyond earliest branching, a sharp jump at three variables to generation-by-generation capped branching, and exact theory counts \(h+1\) versus \(k^h\) with unique minimal representatives. These are structurally motivated logical invariants of a natural tree family, not a fixed small-parameter calculation.
